unchanged_sampling.changed_rule: replace fixed-spacing arrivals by one shared sampled Poisson path per active comparison; all current search, recovery, support floors and terminal integration stay fixed
unchanged_sampling.arrival_path: class-specific exponential gaps at registered lambda, accumulated from decision time 0 to the common H; one path generated and shared by two contenders
unchanged_sampling.rng: per-class random.Random('aligned-planning:{planning_seed}:{coordinate}'), distinct from exogenous aligned-frame streams; each complete run starts fresh and active decisions advance it; no Q-based caching or reseeding
unchanged_sampling.rng_scope: same planning seed crossed with every real arrival seed, load and K; planning state is local to each run and never supplied a real arrival tape or real arrival seed
unchanged_sampling.random_cost: charge every exponential draw, including first beyond H; zero-rate classes make no draw; report RNG initialization count and setup time separately
unchanged_sampling.objective: same complete first-frame plus two pure-batch successor areas and remaining shared-population fluid tail; no old Poisson correction added
unchanged_sampling.budget: one shared sample and exactly two paid successor frames per contender; three planning repetitions are separate full runs, never three free paths in one decision
unchanged_sampling.sampling_limits: single-path argmin is not an expected-cost minimizer; fluid tail and analytic challenger restriction remain
unchanged_sampling.known_counterexample: describe all three fresh planning streams on the previously observed (1,4,8); no requirement to correct its ordering
unchanged_sampling.controls: full-K v4, full-K analytic lookahead and frozen midpoint-arrival rollout; reproduce all 108 old control runs
unchanged_sampling.reference: v4 K120 remains the exact support reference
unchanged_sampling.aggregation: pair each planning repetition against the same real-seed controls; average the three repetitions within each real arrival seed before averaging the original three seeds; report every planning-seed mean and raw range, select none
unchanged_sampling.stopping_rule: all 216 cases once: 108 controls plus 108 Poisson runs; no seed selection or changes to sampling, horizon, terminal rule or budget after outcomes

clipping: no nonnegative truncation or post-sample coefficient fitting
controls: v4 and analytic lookahead each 36; frozen Poisson policy 108 with all three planning repetitions; reproduce all 180 controls
pairing: match Poisson control on load, real seed, K AND planning_seed; ratio per matched run then planning mean within real seed then mean across original real seeds
known_counterexample: all three prior fresh planning samples; raw costs and draws must reproduce; corrected ordering is descriptive, not a required success

variance_diagnostic.rng: aligned-cv-diagnostic:{sample_index}:{coordinate}, independent of full-run planning streams; same sample ids crossed across Q/load
variance_diagnostic.inactive: probe once and retain inactive states without repeating identical non-rollout calls
variance_diagnostic.measure: fixed challenger-minus-incumbent raw and corrected margins, within-state sample variance ratio and paired mean-shift MC error; no cross-state variance pooling or performance gate
variance_diagnostic.cost: all diagnostic searches, draws and coordinate work reported separately; not free work inside online K

stopping_rule: 288 full runs once plus registered diagnostics; no coefficients, sample ids, state roster, horizons or budget changes after outcomes
